notes: Fixed numbered/bulleted lists showing as plain text in Tickets. Fixed a deleted/merged ticket showing as empty instead of a clear error. Fixed bulk-close not updating Open/Past cases. Fixed some attachments not showing up, and garbled special-character filenames. Fixed Ctrl/Cmd+K in canned responses. Added Ticket History. Fixed the Closed view's date filter to mean closed-in-window, not created-in-window. Sped up several slow-loading Tickets views.
